scope: One anonymous current BAC CUSIP mapping candidate capture only; no historical identities, claims, bindings or outcomes.
header_counting: Sum len(name)+len(value) for every parsed httpx response.headers.raw field occurrence, duplicates included; excludes status line, colon/space/CRLF, HTTP2 framing, TLS and wire overhead. Count is measured before body processing. Exceeding16KiB stops with incomplete body. No response header values retained.
anonymous_transport: Fresh httpx Request has only Host and Content-Length plus declared3application headers. Fresh client/transport, retries0, trust_envFalse, no auth/cookies/browser/proxy/config/contact reuse. Explicit certifi CA context avoids ambient SSL key-log/certificate settings.
timeout_semantics: httpx30second connect/read/write/pool timeout; no total network-wire duration guarantee. Attempt/finish clocks and elapsed monotonic checks at headers and each delivered raw chunk retain actual timing; elapsed>=30seconds stops as timeout.
completion: At entity cap without EOF proof, retain exact bounded prefix and classify oversize/incomplete; no cropped complete-body or complete-candidate claim.
derivative_bound_scope: Total bytes of private report.json, report.md and output-hashes.json, including embedded SourceObservation/RawCaptureManifest and input/code/lock/runtime metadata. Raw acquisition object/manifest/receipt remain in capture root and are not copied to derivative output. On overflow publish only bounded report_unavailable diagnostic, no cropped rows/counts.
stop_policy: Global stop on any transport/timeout/non200/401/403/429/redirect/challenge/oversize/privacy/JSON/shape/reference contradiction; no retry, alternate id, venue filter, enum GET, search, pagination or replacement. A complete no-result or ambiguous result also ends the one-request scope.
privacy_policy: Fresh non-sync local AppData outside Git/cloud. Immutable content-addressed exact response entity bytes, request-body hash, UTC aware start/finish, status/content-type/safe rate-limit headers, byte count and completeness plus versioned append-only/checkpoint receipt. Partial bytes remain private; no header values/cookies/exception text or reflected sensitive body copied to public output. Do not mutate blocked raw; reject any public replay before output.
